item.title: Pentagon plan to livestream Fort Hood execution draws debate
item.description: The planned livestream marks a sharp break from recent US execution practice: capital punishment in the military and civilian systems has for decades been conducted with limited witnesses rather than broadcast to the public. item.title: U.S. imposes sweeping sanctions on International Criminal Court
item.description: The ICC is the world's only permanent war-crimes tribunal, established in 2002 to prosecute genocide, crimes against humanity, war crimes and aggression across its 125 member states. item.title: Anthropic cuts internal AI evaluations from internet after agents submit false murder tip, exploit government sites
